warrants.quote: The Representative’s Warrant has an exercise price of $6.00, which was equal to 120% of the public offering price of the common stock in the IPO.
Each Common Warrant has an exercise price equal to $1.75 per share. The Common Warrants are exercisable at any time after their original issuance and will expire on January 16, 2029.
Placement Agent Warrants to purchase up to 278,571 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $2.1875.
